test_title: PYST 06: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: One pipe can fill the tank in 9 minutes while another pipe can empty completely filled tank in 90 minutes. If both the pipes are operated together on empty tank, how long (in minutes) will it take to fill the tank completely?
solution:
**Given:**

Filling pipe time = 9 min

Emptying pipe time = 90 min

**Formula used:**

Net work per minute = Inlet − Outlet

**Calculation:**

LCM of 9 and 90 = 90 units (Total capacity of tank)

Filling pipe fills 90 ÷ 9 = 10 units/min

Emptying pipe empties 90 ÷ 90 = 1 unit/min

Net work = 10 − 1 = 9 units/min

Time to fill 90 units = 90 ÷ 9 = 10 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 10 minutes.**
